changelog.name: v3.0.9
changelog.body:
## v3.0.9「10.3KB · 终极极简」

- 恢复 ColorOS 应用间跳转确认框的「始终允许打开」复选框，真实生效
- 无界面、无设置、启用即生效（静态作用域）
- 10.3KB：去掉 service 库死重 + R8 业务收缩
- 726 项逻辑测试通过，ColorOS 17 / Android 17 实测可用

---

Restores the "Always allow to open" checkbox in ColorOS app-jump confirmations — and it actually works. No UI, no settings, 10.3KB.

LSPosed 模块：恢复 ColorOS 应用间跳转确认框的「始终允许打开」复选框，真实生效。无界面、无设置、启用即生效，APK 仅 9.4KB。

Restores the "Always allow to open" checkbox in ColorOS app-jump confirmations — and it actually works. No UI, no settings, 9.4KB.
